purpose: Numerical/rule correctness only; no historical model performance or promotion claim
interval: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson with Bonferroni over all 22 cases
scope: Legacy MC is compared against exact game-level DP under the SAME hold-ratio tie-break approximation. Point-level 7/10-point oracle is separately compared to point MC. Agreement does not validate legacy approximation against real tennis outcomes.
historical_rules: Explicit tiebreak target required; tournament/year mapping remains a separate data contract, never infer modern rules for historical matches.
